summary.overview: The candidate-facing workflow has strong fact and overwrite safeguards, but Audit mode has a contradictory file-creation boundary and maintainers lack a repeatable validation route for the core skill and template.

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: The workflow and source-of-truth rules are detailed, but Audit mode carries conflicting completion effects.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: Document generation names compiler and fallback routes, while reproducible repository operation remains unobserved.

dimensions.label: Change Validation
dimensions.summary: No project-owned check validates the skill contract, template compilation, or extracted reading order after changes.

dimensions.label: Reliable Delivery
dimensions.summary: Candidate output safeguards are present, but revision-bound review, CI, and recovery evidence were outside the observed repository boundary.

dimensions.label: Learning Capture
dimensions.summary: No eligible task episodes or comparable outcome windows were available, so reusable learning effectiveness is unobserved.

findings.title: Audit mode can cross its own no-file boundary
findings.reason: The Audit workflow says not to create files until the candidate agrees to continue, while the unconditional deliverables section instructs the agent to create a final resume, LaTeX source, and PDF unless the user opts out. An agent following the later default can write candidate artifacts before the required consent boundary.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Make the deliverables explicitly workflow-specific in skills/recruiter-ready-cv/SKILL.md so Audit returns findings only until the candidate agrees to enter Update. Preserve the existing Create and Update outputs and the no-overwrite rule.

## Validation

- Inspect the Audit workflow and deliverables together and confirm they specify one file-creation boundary
- Run gh skill publish --dry-run
- Confirm README.md describes the same Audit result
expectedOutput: Give Audit mode one unambiguous consent gate before any structured resume, LaTeX, or PDF is created.

findings.title: Core skill and template changes lack a repeatable acceptance check
findings.reason: The repository's main behavior lives in SKILL.md and the bundled LaTeX template, but the inspected project contains no project-owned command or fixture that validates packaging, template compilation, placeholder removal, and extracted PDF reading order after a change. Maintainers must reconstruct these checks ad hoc, so regressions in the primary artifact path can reach review without repeatable evidence.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Add the smallest repository-owned validation route for the recruiter-ready-cv skill and bundled LaTeX template. Reuse gh skill publish --dry-run for packaging and the documented pdflatex plus PDF text-extraction path for one deterministic fixture; do not add unrelated frameworks.

## Validation

- Run the new focused validation route from the repository root
- Confirm it fails for an invalid template or leaked placeholder and passes on the checked-in final state
- Retain the exact command and output location for future maintainers
expectedOutput: Provide one repository-owned command that produces repeatable packaging, compilation, and reading-order evidence for the core artifact path.
